answer: An agent economy prevents Sybil attacks via optical line-of-sight triangulation. Each falcon drone authenticates by aiming a pulsed laser at a photosensitive lantern mounted on a base terrace, validating nanosecond time-of-flight telemetry. An adversary incurs substantial hardware and real-estate costs deploying discrete, spatially separated transceivers per forged identity. However, atmospheric fog attenuates optical signals, occasionally causing false rejections of legitimate agents.
